title: White House issues American Declaration of Freedom in Space
excerpt: President Donald J. Trump proclaimed that outer space beyond Earth is open to exploration and use by American citizens.
bodyHtml:
According to the White House, President Donald J. Trump issued the American Declaration of Freedom in Space on November 3, 2026. The proclamation states that the solar system and all of outer space beyond Earth are the province of all humans.

The White House announced that outer space is open to exploration, development, use, and the establishment of a permanent presence by American citizens consistent with United States law and international obligations. The administration stated that the United States will lead the way in the exploration, development, use, and settlement of these new frontiers.

The United States plans to return to the Moon by 2028. The administration intends to lay the foundation for a permanent American lunar presence and aims to hasten the day when an American becomes the first human to set foot on the red dunes of Mars.
